evals.prompt: Build a review package for the accepted James Holub Wave 1 and Wave 2 artifacts. Keep HubSpot and Twenty unavailable and do not trigger A2.
evals.expected_output: One schema-valid canonical candidate ranked for human review with score 86/High, confidence 84/High, visible limitations and pending decision.

evals.prompt: Rank a mixed batch containing an accepted candidate, a High-score Low-confidence candidate and an excluded candidate.
evals.expected_output: Deterministic accept, needs_research and reject ordering without changing scores or approving any candidate.

evals.prompt: Build a review package where two candidates share the same public business domain.
evals.expected_output: The batch duplicate check flags a possible match and both affected candidates require research rather than automatic acceptance.
